body: Conclusion: conditional safest no-shared-clock wiring is INMP441 SCK=GPIO14, WS=GPIO47, SD=GPIO48, L/R=GND; SPEAKER2 BCLK=GPIO1, LRC=GPIO2, DOUT=GPIO3. This uses I2S0 RX and I2S1 TX. GPIO3 is an S3 JTAG-source strapping pin: datasheet says no internal pull and it must not be high-Z at reset; add an external 10 kΩ pull-up to 3V3 on GPIO3 (then it becomes normal I/O after reset) and boot/USB-JTAG test. GPIO45 MUST NOT be used: VDD_SPI voltage strap, high at reset can select 1.8 V. GPIO0 is already BOOT/record button. If GPIO3 is not physically exposed or strap use is unacceptable, strict separate I2S buses are impossible using non-strap pins 1,2,14,47,48; add a genuine free ESP32-S3 GPIO/flywire or change hardware. Desktop/2 hardware_modules.md does not actually list GPIO3/45 as exposed; verify from board schematic/photo. The M5 SPEAKER2 code only proves BCLK/LRC/DOUT mapping, not VCC rail; local hardware doc also says amp power is unresolved.
Converged: conditional independent-I2S redesign selected. GPIO3 physical accessibility and boot behavior are mandatory pre-solder checks; GPIO45 rejected.
